title: Lesson 7: Replication & Scaling the Read Tier — js-tools
desc: The three purposes of a replica need three different configurations, and a replica is not a backup; going from async to sync raises write latency 79% and cuts write throughput 44%; the headline finding — a replication lag of just 0.557 ms still breaks read-your-writes on 87.21% of reads, because what decides it is whether the lag is larger than the gap between that user's write and their read; both fixes reach 0% at a cost of 4.6% and 12.6% throughput; and split-brain reproduced for real with docker network disconnect plus pg_promote.
